t: The Bosch Expert SelfCut Speed hex shank flat wood spade drill bit set provides efficient and fast drilling in various wood types. These heat-treated spade drill bits are engineered for speed, cutting up to 3x faster than standard bits. This drill bit set is highly effective for overhead work or within confined spaces, as the high-speed self-feeding threaded tip draws the bit into the material with minimal pressure. The paddle design contributes to additional drilling speed, ensuring rapid working on site. A hex shank ensures maximum power transfer with standard 3-jaw drills and hexagonal screwdriver chucks. Suitable for softwoods, chipboard, and particleboard.
b: Suitable for Natural Hardwood & Softwood, Plywood, Chipboard & Hardboard
For Use with 3-Jaw & 1/4" Hex Chuck Machines on Rotary Action
Hex Shank for Maximum Power Transfer
Paddle Design Delivers Additional Drilling Speed
Ideal for Drilling in Tight Spaces or Overhead
